description: Figma to web, checked: per-section geometry, pixel, colour and style checks plus a responsive audit

plugins.name: figma-pixel-check
plugins.description: Independent Figma fidelity checks for web frontends, whoever builds them: per-section geometry, pixels (with hotspots), colours and Figma's own style values, in every state the design draws, plus a responsive audit at six phone sizes. Plain Node + Playwright, deterministic, with CI gates and an HTML report.
